evidence_down.evidence_note: Real. HKFP, Hans Tse, "11 jailed democrats granted permission to appeal to top court", published 2026-08-10, https://hongkongfp.com/2026/08/10/hong-kong-47-11-jailed-democrats-granted-permission-to-appeal-to-top-court/. Secondary: HKFP month-74 explainer, 2026-09-07, https://hongkongfp.com/2026/09/07/explainer-hong-kongs-national-security-crackdown-month-74/.
pushes: New information that adds to the fact sheet: on 10 August 2026 the Court of Appeal certified that the appeals of 11 of the jailed defendants, including Gwyneth Ho, Leung Kwok-hung and Clarisse Yeung, involve five points of law 'of great and general importance', including the meaning of 'unlawful means' under the national security law. That certificate is the statutory precondition for the Court of Final Appeal to grant leave to appeal. The three judges, led by Chief Judge Jeremy Poon, said the appeals 'merit the consideration by the Court of Final Appeal, in particular when it is the first occasion they are to be determined by our apex court.' Hong Kong Free Press reported that the 11 had won permission to appeal to the top court. Does that change your rating?
